package repository

import (
	"context"
	"testing"
)

func TestDeferAfterCommitWithoutTransactionRunsImmediatelyAtCaller(t *testing.T) {
	called := false
	deferred := DeferAfterCommit(context.Background(), func() { called = true })

	if deferred {
		t.Fatal("callback unexpectedly deferred without a transaction scope")
	}
	if called {
		t.Fatal("helper must not execute an immediate callback on the caller's behalf")
	}
}

func TestTransactionScopeRunsCallbacksInRegistrationOrder(t *testing.T) {
	ctx, scope := WithTransactionScope(context.Background())
	var order []int
	if !DeferAfterCommit(ctx, func() { order = append(order, 1) }) {
		t.Fatal("first callback was not deferred")
	}
	if !DeferAfterCommit(ctx, func() { order = append(order, 2) }) {
		t.Fatal("second callback was not deferred")
	}

	scope.RunAfterCommit()
	scope.RunAfterCommit()

	if len(order) != 2 || order[0] != 1 || order[1] != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected callback order: %v", order)
	}
}
